messages:
kai: quick experiment: enabling scheduler soft-affinity override for tainted GPU nodes in eu-west1 for 2h. goal: reduce evictions during spot backfills. rolling at 12:30UTC. will monitor cost delta. ping @maggie for canary list.

maggie: ack. remind me which pools are affected? dev and prod?

kai: just prod-gpu-pool-1 and prod-gpu-pool-2. dev unchanged. config: set nodeSelector preference + weight 0.6 and allow tolerationSeconds 300.

sam.h: won't that let some non-gang jobs sneak onto packed hosts? worried about tail latency.

kai: good point. adding a conservative cap: per-node max-gpu-alloc 8 -> unchanged. also disable inter-az burst to avoid net-saturation.

infra-bot: deploybot: started rollout config-scheduler/soft-affinity-exp -> 10% nodes -> 1749862345

aj: observing leftover pending in ap-southeast1 with 'InsufficientGPUs' despite free CPU. looks like fragmentation + SKU mismatch.

kai: ap-southeast1 isn't part of this experiment, but noted. can you paste the pending pods list?

aj: ```
NAME              READY STATUS  RESTARTS  AGE  NODE  REQUESTS
train-job-42      0/1   Pending 0         3m   -     nvidia.com/gpu: 0.25
inference-batch-7 0/1   Pending 0         1m   -     nvidia.com/gpu: 0.5
``` 

maggie: we should clamp gpu request min to 1 for prod jobs. fractional requests only allowed in dev.

kai: agree. adding admission webhook rule: if namespace==prod && gpu_request < 1 -> deny.

sam.h: quick metric: cost +2.3% (less packing) but evictions down -76% in prod-gpu-pool-1. /metrics query shows tail latency improved.

kai: nice tradeoff. leaving experiment for 2h then rollback if cost >5% or net attach >85%.

devops-bot: alert: network attach limit at 90% in eu-west1-rack-3, recommend throttling attach ops.

aj: holding canary; paused rollout at 40% until network attach issue resolved.

kai: :thumbsup: paused. i'll open follow-up issue to implement admission clamp + deprecate fractional gpu in prod. thanks all.
